blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A school principal was shot dead by still unidentified gunmen in Barangay Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, on Wednesday morning. Lt. Mohammad U Ali of Datu Saudi Ampatuan municipal police, identified the victim as Dr. Dionel Villavito Mahusay, Ed.D., principal of Datu Pendililang Piang Elementary School in Barangay Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur.
